name: Dev-via-spec Challenger Accept → Architect Handoff
description: When the dev-via-spec-challenger emits decide(action=accept), the adversarial gate has passed and the plan is committed. This rule fires on that signal and spawns the dev-via-spec-architect for the curation pass — extracting the chain consensus from the challenger's accept reason, structuring it via emit_dev_via_spec_artifact (R3.4b), which renders a human-readable markdown spec to docs/specs/ and mints marker triples on the calling loop. The architect's decide(tasks_emitted) is terminal — no further rule fires. ADR-031 §addendum 2026-05-02.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.dev-via-spec-architect
on_enter.prompt:
The dev-via-spec challenger accepted the plan. Challenger loop id: $entity.instance. Research artifact loop id: $entity.triple.lineage.researcher.

Iteration 1: Call read_loop_result on the challenger loop id ($entity.instance) to read the chain consensus (the challenger's verdict reason summarises plan + actors + integration_points). Then call read_loop_result on the research artifact loop id ($entity.triple.lineage.researcher) to read the research artifact — its `harness` field names the catalog test_harness reference you must cite in any check whose runtime is `process-local-testcontainer`.

Iteration 2: Extract the chain's substance (goal, context, actors, integration_points, tasks as epic-shaped scope items, checks with resolved test_harness references, provenance loop_ids) and call emit_dev_via_spec_artifact with structured args per your `10-output-contract.md`. The tool renders the markdown spec artifact to docs/specs/ and mints marker triples for downstream audit.

Iteration 3: Terminate with decide(action=tasks_emitted, reason="spec emitted: <slug>. <one-line summary>"). Rule_06 fires on tasks_emitted to spawn the builder.

metadata.pattern: architect (ported from SemSpec architect, scoped down — research artifact provided actors/integration_points)
metadata.terminal_role_note: architect's decide(tasks_emitted) is non-terminal as of slice 3 (ADR-036) — rule_06 (architect-emit-to-builder) fires on tasks_emitted to spawn the dev-via-spec-builder.
metadata.cross_grounding_resolved: Slice 4c (semstreams beta.51 + this rule edit) closed the architect-needs-research-lineage gap from smoke #8 run-2. related_loops carries lineage.researcher forward through every dev-via-spec hop via $entity.triple.lineage.researcher substitution. Architect substitutes the literal research_loop_id into its own prompt body and calls read_loop_result on it for the harness reference. Rule_03 mode-transition is the source — it stamps lineage.researcher on the planner's spawn from the research-reviewer's lineage.researcher (which rule_01a/01b stamped from the researcher's $entity.instance).
